decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the five Salt Lake County parcels owned by Novva SLC Common LLC / Novva SLC North, LLC on W Wells Park Rd and W Old Bingham Hwy, West Jordan, including the parcel at 6477 W Wells Park Rd (the address Novva published for its Utah data center), as the campus locator of Novva's flagship Utah campus.

selected_properties.layer: Salt Lake County slcogis Land/MapServer layer 1 (Parcels), queried with outSR=4326; the query selects parcels whose owner name begins NOVVA or whose situs begins 6477 W WELLS PARK and returns exactly these five parcels

computed.method: Polygons returned with outSR=4326; union and centroid computed in EPSG:32612 (WGS 84 / UTM 12N) and returned to WGS84; an EPSG:5070 (CONUS Albers) cross-check gives the same point; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: Novva's Utah page (Internet Archive copy of 14 July 2026, version modified 13 July 2026) gives the Utah data center's address as 6477 West Wells Park Road, West Jordan, UT 84081; the current version (modified 10 September 2026) describes the same flagship 100-acre West Jordan campus without the street address.

The county parcel at situs 6477 W WELLS PARK RD (26-10-276-012, 21.89 acres) is owned by NOVVA SLC NORTH, LLC; the four adjoining parcels (6593 and 6381 W Wells Park Rd, 6377 W Wells Park Rd and 6524 W Old Bingham Hwy) are owned by NOVVA SLC COMMON LLC / NOVVA SLC COMMON, LLC. All five are lot use I (industrial) and were split in 2024-2025 from earlier parcels.
The five parcels form one contiguous polygon of 94.55 geodesic acres, consistent with the 100-acre campus Novva describes; the union centroid lies inside the 6477 W Wells Park Rd parcel.
The City of West Jordan's 19 March 2025 article locates the NOVVA Data Center just west of the Mountain View Corridor, which is consistent with these parcels.
unresolved: The county parcel records carry no year built or building area for these recently re-split parcels, so the individual data-centre buildings are not located; the point represents the campus.
Novva describes a four-phase, 1.5 million sq ft build-out; which phases are built is not published, so the record covers existing operations only.
nearby_records: No Atlas site, project, source record, identity-mapping entry, pending fragment, claim or hold coordinate lies within 2 km; the nearest Atlas site is the DataBank Granite Point Campus in Bluffdale, about 15.7 km away.

consistency_checks.datum: WGS84 output from the county service (outSR=4326)
